title: Falcons are "aware" of suggestion that James Pearce Jr. has been trying to contact Rickea Jackson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Falcons are "aware" of suggestion that James Pearce Jr. has been trying to contact Rickea Jackson
sources.description: Falcons defensive end James Pearce Jr. has returned from an eight-game suspension arising from an incident with his former girlfriend, WNBA player Rickea Jackson.
